title: Soul Snack #72: Your Life Is An Adventure
excerpt: Are you making choices in love or fear?
bodyHtml:
Are you making choices in love or fear? Take this self-assessment today to find out.

https://youtu.be/rtGI4EF3ybc

In this transformative Soul Snack, Gary Zukav invites you to recognize your life in the Earth School as the grand adventure it truly is – unfolding in this very moment. Set within the context of humanity’s unprecedented shift in consciousness, Gary explores how a new world is being born while the old world of external power disintegrates, and how both worlds are calling to your Soul. Through his compassionate guidance, he reveals how every experience presents a Responsible Choice and how awakening to this adventure allows you to appreciate your journey, your spiritual evolution, and even the frightened parts of your personality that challenge you.

The central challenge facing multisensory humanity is navigating between two worlds – one rooted in gratitude, patience, contentment, and awe of the Universe, and another trapped in the anger, worry, and despair of the five-sensory personality. 

Each moment of this adventure brings experiences that call for a conscious choice, determining whether you create from fear-based reactions or love-based intentions.

The solution lies in awakening to your life as an intentional adventure in the Earth School and appreciating each experience as a tailored opportunity to create Authentic Power. When love is chosen over fear consistently, the door opens to Spiritual Partnership with others who are also committed to living as aware, Universal Humans.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Snack:

  • (00:02) — The Leap in Consciousness: Gary explores the unprecedented shift in human awareness and the profound choice between the world of external power and the emerging multisensory reality.
  • (00:29) — Life as a Present-Moment Adventure: A deep look at recognizing your life in the Earth School as an ongoing adventure unfolding right now, rather than a collection of past events.
  • (00:57) — The Constant Invitation to Choice: Understanding how the Universe continuously presents experiences that require a Responsible Choice between the frightened and loving parts of your personality.
  • (01:49) — Appreciating the Curriculum of the Soul: Gary explains how awakening allows you to appreciate your own journey and those who challenge you as potential Spiritual Partners in the creation of Authentic Power.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

Take a moment this week to recognize your life as the adventure it is right now. When you encounter a challenging situation or person, pause and ask yourself: Am I choosing love or fear in this moment? Can I appreciate this experience as part of my adventure in the Earth School? Notice what happens when you consciously choose to respond with love rather than react from fear, and observe how this choice shapes your ongoing adventure.
